verdict.rationale: Evidence shows budget/rate-limit and key management as dashboard-configurable features (docs-13, docs-25, docs-35, docs-38) but never describes a programmatic Admin API for provisioning gateways, keys, or budgets; the only API reference documented is the inference API (docs-15, docs-16, docs-36), and probes for an OpenAPI/admin API spec returned 404 (portkey-probe-3, portkey-probe-2).
